name: Gas Pipeline Branch to Sol-Iletsk (Orenburg Oblast)
monitor_reason: length / threshold: 29 km is sourced only to the 2013 planning scheme (decree 1416-r, planned build Jul 2013-Jul 2014); no sponsor, no concrete step (no permit/tender/FEED/FID), outside the 3-year window, and no evidence it was built or re-announced
researcher_notes: No match in GEM roster/snapshot (no Iletsk/Sol-Iletsk row; nearest are Orenburg-Samara P2364, Orenburg-Zainsk P2365, not this). Decree 1416-r (13 Aug 2013) scheme text: gas pipeline branch to Sol-Iletsk (GPR I), Orenburg Oblast, part of the Unified Gas Supply System, single stage, single-line aboveground, planned 29 km, through Sol-Iletsk and Orenburg districts, start planned Jul 2013, commissioning Jul 2014, supplies consumers of Sol-Iletsk district centre. The scheme was superseded by decree 816-r (6 May 2015); the Sol-Iletsk branch text is absent from the 816-r scheme text checked, i.e. dropped. Searches (Russian) for build/tender/re-announcement found no evidence of construction or sponsor; local gasification news covers only inter-settlement and in-village distribution lines. Planning-scheme item only; the 29 km is a planned figure. Re-open if a sponsor (Gazprom / Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Orenburg) or a tender surfaces. Confidence low.
